text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty Alert fired: PD-98721 - throttler-heartbeat missing for region us-west-2, automated quota enforcement engaged for ~120 tenants. Severity: P1

pagerduty: PD-98721 acknowledged by ashwin at 2026-03-14T09:05:12Z

ashwin: acked. seeing a big spike in 429s from the proxy metrics dashboard. tenant error rate up ~18%  in last 3m.

maria: confirmed in SLO dashboard — median latency ok but 429s jumping. looks concentrated on tenant shard-12 and shard-19.

kevin: any recent config deploys to throttler? I don't see a prod deploy in the last 24h.

lia: no config deploys from my side. heartbeat service (quota-mapper) logs show repeated connection timeouts to redis cluster 10.2.4.x around 09:02 UTC.

ashwin: copying logs excerpt:```ERROR quota-mapper: failed to refresh heartbeat for region us-west-2: dial tcp 10.2.4.12:6379: i/o timeout (retry 3)```

ashwin: hypothesis: redis flake caused quota-mapper to mark limiter as unhealthy, which flipped enforcement to 'fail-closed' for affected shards. enforcement should fall back to a permissive mode but it didn't.

maria: customers impacted list from our routing trace: team-a-prod, realtime-search, notifications-svc (about 5% of traffic each).

ashwin: mitigation plan: 1) disable automated enforcement gate for us-west-2 2) scale quota-mapper replicas 3) open an incident to Platform for redis flaps. executing step 1 now.

kevin: can you run the emergency toggle? I don't have perms. ashwin will run `curl -XPOST https://control-plane/api/v1/flags/throttler.enforce?region=us-west-2 --data '{"value":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'`

ashwin: executed. control-plane returned 200. enforcement flag for us-west-2 set to false. monitoring: 429 rate dropping within 60s. :white_check_mark:

lia: scaling quota-mapper from 3 -> 6 replicas in k8s: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment/quota-mapper --replicas=6`

lia: quota-mapper logs now show successful redis reconnects and heartbeat refreshes.

kevin: good. are there any tenants still 429ing?

maria: edge traces show residual 429s clearing out — estimated customer impact window ~ 09:02:00 -> 09:07:30 UTC. About 18 tenants saw transient throttles.

customer-success: FYI — we have one SE pinging about realtime-search errors; I've posted a short status on status.redwood.ai: "Partial quota enforcement anomaly impacting some tenants in us-west-2. Mitigated. Investigating root cause."

ashwin: next steps: - keep enforcement disabled for 30m while we validate redis stability - revert to strict after successful soak - create postmortem and tag Platform and SRE for redis investigation - assign owner for follow-up on enforcement fallthrough logic

kevin: I'm taking owner for remediation item: add a safe-default permissive path when quota-mapper health is unknown. Will open an RFC and a follow-up ticket.

lia: adding node-level dashboard alerts for redis connection error rate > 5% in a minute.

sre-bot: PagerDuty escalation: notifying on-call infra-team.

ashwin: handing off to maria for the 09:30-17:30 shift. maria, please validate after 30 min and update PD.

maria: acknowledged. I'll run a synthetic traffic test in ~10m to confirm no silent regressions and post results here.

ashwin: thanks. closing pager duty alert for my ack — will re-open if we see recurring spike. PD note: incident closed by ashwin at 2026-03-14T09:12:30Z (mitigated, monitoring).

maria: synthetic test started. sending 2k req/s for 3m to shard-12 and shard-19.

maria: synthetic results: no 429s observed, steady latency, redis connection errors at baseline. marking mitigated.

kevin: filed follow-up ticket INFRA-4532: "throttler enforcement should fallback to permissive when quota-mapper health is unknown" and linked logs + timeline.

ashwin: adding timeline to incident thread and will draft a short postmortem. Great job team, quick mitigation. :tada:

maria: will keep monitoring for next 2h then hand to oncall night shift.

customer-success: I've emailed affected account contacts with the timeline and apology.

sre-bot: Incident PD-98721 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Last update 2026-03-14T09:45:50Z

maria: closing thread.
